# Merahi

> Merahi is a rural farming village in the Hasanpura block of Siwan district, Bihar, India — explore its people, places, culture and everyday life.

## Explore Merahi Village - Places

- [Shiv Mandir, Merahi | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/shiv-mandir.html): Shiv Mandir on Sharmaji Chowk Road — the oldest temple in Merahi village, Siwan, Bihar
- [Maa Kali Mandir, Merahi | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/maa-kali-mandir.html): Maa Kali Mandir on the Hasanpura Road, Merahi — a peaceful temple with an open field beside it where local children gather to play
- [Pakari Panchayat — Merahi's Gram Panchayat | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/pakari-panchayat.html): Pakari Gram Panchayat, Hasanpura block, Siwan — the panchayat Merahi village falls under. Mukhiya, office timings, services available, helpline numbers, and demographics
- [Braham Baba, Merahi | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/brahma-baba.html): Braham Baba — a worshipped peepal tree in Merahi village, with a related Brahmsthan shrine nearby on the Dibi-Merahi road
- [Primary School, Merahi | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/primary-school.html): Primary School page for Merahi Village
- [Chhath Ghat, Merahi | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/chhath-ghat.html): Chhath Ghat, also known as Meraha — the village pond in Merahi used for cattle, irrigation and Chhath Puja celebrations
- [Primary Health Centre, Jalalpur — Healthcare Near Merahi | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/primary-health-center-jalalpur.html): Primary Health Centre (Community Health Centre), Jalalpur — the nearest government healthcare facility serving Merahi and surrounding villages in Hasanpura block, Siwan district
- [Ram Janki, Durga, Shiv Mandir | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/ram-janki-durga-shiv-mandir.html): Ram Janki, Durga, Shiv Mandir — Merahi village

## Main Pages

- [Merahi Village — Our Village, Our Identity](https://merahi-village.github.io/index.html): Merahi is a rural farming village in the Hasanpura block of Siwan district, Bihar, India — explore its people, places, culture and everyday life
- [Places in Merahi Village | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places.html): Explore the landmarks and community places of Merahi village — Chhath Ghat, Shiv Mandir, Ram Janki Durga Shiv Mandir, Brahma Baba and the village primary school
- [About Merahi Village — Geography, People & Life | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/about-village.html): Merahi is a farming village in the Hasanpura block of Siwan district, Bihar, India. Learn about its geography, people, governance, economy, education and culture
- [Photo Gallery | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/gallery.html): All the real photos of Merahi village - Chhath Ghat, Shiv Mandir, Ram Janki Durga Shiv Mandir, Brahma Baba, the Primary School and village farmland
- [Videos | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/videos.html): Watch Merahi village on video — Chhath Ghat, Ram Janki Durga Shiv Mandir, Brahma Baba and the Primary School, from the official Merahi Village YouTube channel
- [Merahi Weather Dashboard | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/weather.html): Live weather dashboard for Merahi village, Siwan, Bihar — today
- [Contact Us | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/contact-us.html): Get in touch with Merahi Village — send a message and it reaches the village community team directly
- [Sitemap | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/sitemap.html): A complete list of every page on the Merahi Village website
- [Website Policies | Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/policies.html): Privacy, terms, cookies, third-party services and data collection details for the Merahi Village website
